plain_description: Rebuff protects your AI applications from prompt injection attacks, one of the most critical security risks in generative AI. It uses four layers of defense to detect and block malicious inputs before they can compromise your system. The bottom line: add robust, self-hardening security to your LLM apps without building detection from scratch.
technical_description: Rebuff is a multi-layered prompt injection detection framework providing Python and JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs. It integrates with OpenAI's API for LLM-based detection, vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma) for attack signature learning and matching, and Supabase for server-side data management. The framework employs four detection layers: heuristic filtering, LLM-based prompt analysis, vector database attack recognition, and canary token leakage detection. A self-hosted Next.js server provides a REST API and playground UI, with configurable billing and credit tracking.
title: Rebuff
